lines.targetText: 早上好，莱斯。您的项目想法是什么？
lines.englishReference: Good morning, Laith. What is your project idea?
lines.arabicTranslation: صباح الخير يا ليث. What is your project idea?
lines.pronunciation: zǎo shàng hǎo, lái sī. nín de xiàng mù xiǎng fǎ shì shén me.

lines.targetText: 早上好。我想为我们的产品做一个标志。
lines.englishReference: Good morning. I want to make a sign for our products.
lines.arabicTranslation: صباح الخير. I want to make a sign for our products.
lines.pronunciation: zǎo shàng hǎo. wǒ xiǎng wèi wǒ men de chǎn pǐn zuò yí gè biāo zhì.

lines.targetText: 我们什么时候可以完成它？
lines.pronunciation: wǒ men shén me shí hòu kě yǐ wán chéng tā.

lines.targetText: 我们可以在星期五之前完成。
lines.englishReference: We can finish it by Friday.
lines.arabicTranslation: We can finish it by Friday.
lines.pronunciation: wǒ men kě yǐ zài xīng qī wǔ zhī qián wán chéng.

lines.englishReference: Who will help you with the wood?
lines.arabicTranslation: Who will help you with the wood?
lines.pronunciation: shuí lái bāng nǐ ná mù tou.

lines.targetText: 加斯顿说他可以帮助我。
lines.englishReference: Gaston said he can help me.
lines.arabicTranslation: Gaston said he can help me.
lines.pronunciation: jiā sī dùn shuō tā kě yǐ bāng zhù wǒ.

lines.englishReference: That sounds like a good plan.
lines.pronunciation: zhè tīng qǐ lái shì gè hǎo jì huà.

scenes.promptArabic: انقل مهارة اليوم إلى حياتك: الحديث عن مشروع عمل.

scenes.purposeArabic: استماع جانبي طبيعي بلا كشف مبكر.

lines.englishReference: The market is changing quickly this season.
lines.pronunciation: běn jì shì chǎng biàn huà hěn kuài.

lines.targetText: 是的。人们对古老道路提出了更多问题。
lines.englishReference: Yes. People are asking more questions about old roads.
lines.arabicTranslation: نعم. الناس يسألون أكثر عن الطرق القديمة.
lines.pronunciation: shì de. rén men duì gǔ lǎo dào lù tí chū le gèng duō wèn tí.
